filing_office: Arkansas Secretary of State, Business and Commercial Services
filing_fee_notes: Online fee is 45; paper fee is 50. Name reservation is 22.5 online or 25 on paper.
registered_agent_rules: Provide a registered agent and physical street address. The agent must be located at an Arkansas street address; a P.O. box or mail drop is not acceptable.
annual_report_due: May 1 each year, beginning the year after formation.
franchise_or_privilege_tax: Annual LLC franchise tax is 150, paid with the annual report; this is the same 150 recorded in annual_report_fee, not an additional charge. Online payment adds a 5 processing fee.
state_tax_registration_agency: Arkansas Department of Finance and Administration
plain_english_summary: File the Certificate of Organization. File the franchise tax report and pay the tax each year.
common_mistake: Missing the May 1 franchise tax deadline.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. Formation URL is the official forms gateway; choose domestic LLC online filing. Processing time, expedite options, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed and are null.
